quest.title: Paleontological Investigation in The Chasm
quest.description: You notice some rocks with peculiar markings on them. It's better to take a few pictures. Perhaps someone might know what these are...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x60000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the strange rock we found...

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: So, you took a picture or two of some strange rocks?

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Ah! Look at the picture! It's so clear — seems the new Kamera models from Fontaine are as good as they say.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: I once bought some prototype ones, but the images captured weren't clear enough. Besides, they were too clumsy to be handled by one person alone. So they ended up rotting away in some corner in the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Yep, it cost me a meal's worth of Mora. Um... Looks like it's time that I bought some new Kameras.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: But anyway, I've digressed. Let me have a look. This rock...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Yes, it's a fossil!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A fossil?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Yes, and you can see many fossilized marine creatures in it... How curious! In Liyue, there's a saying for this — I don't know the exact wording, but it goes something like "forests and fields are eventually engulfed by the vast ocean."

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: The fact that the fossil appears in The Chasm proves that these creatures were buried underground in an instant. Otherwise, their skeletons wouldn't be so perfectly preserved.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: By the way, I heard that this place has frequent earthquakes. It makes sense, as one of the prerequisites for fossil formation is active geological movements.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: This finding will certainly shed new light on our understanding of the ancient creatures that once inhabited this place...

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: But I think I could use a few more pictures.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: If you come across other such fossils, please take pictures for me.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How many do you need?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Let me see. I need four or five for my report... You know what? Let's make it five. Bring me five pictures of similar rocks.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: I'll offer a reasonable price for this, of course. It is a big discovery, and that is no understatement.

choices.text: That's a bit of a waste...

talks.objective: Give the fossil pictures to Khedive

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Great, these are some nice pictures!

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Certainly worth the resources of the exploration team.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Look, these are all bones of ancient marine creatures. You can see their structure very clearly.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: This means that this place used to be beneath the ocean's surface before it became The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: What a pity we aren't in Sumeru. Otherwise, I would have them brought back to the Akademiya to begin research right away.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: We can't afford to have miners accidentally tampering with these fossils. We need to hire people to take some precautions. Yes, I'll bring this up next time I meet up with the people of the Ministry.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: I'll... settle for these ones.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: But as I said, these fossils are perfectly preserved, their structure intact. And this means one thing.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: That they were buried underground in an instant.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Nearly all fossils you found at The Chasm are located at a fixed altitude.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Well, geologically speaking, the difference in height is minuscule.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: This means it was a quick process — and nearly all fossils here formed at almost the same time. Basically, something must've radically altered the ecosystem here in a split-second.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: I'd say something like a huge shock wave, of sorts.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Hmm, what could've happened in The Chasm?

choices.text: It's not that fixed, is it?
You're not gonna tell me you need more pictures, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's the pictures of the fossils you asked for...
